Name: Wildflower Grass
Author: alsciaucat
Description:
Update note: Nexus search failed me, minervamaga has already done this! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3478 ]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3478 [/url]

---

Since Eemie isn't making mods anymore, but [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34984615]has left porting available[/url], I've converted their wonderful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1235]Wildflower mod[/url] into a Content Patcher edition.

All sprites were created by Eemie. I have simply made them compatible with SMAPI & Content Patcher.

[size=4]Installation instructions[/size]

1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], if you haven't already
2. Dowload & extract the archive
3. Place the [code][CP] Wildflower Grass[/code] folder into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder

[size=4]Configuration options[/size]

By default, the "more flowers" options is disabled. If you are unsatisfied with this and want [i]even more[/i] flowers, edit [code]config.json[/code] and set the [code]moreFlowers[/code] option to [code]"true"[/code].
